name: Park Hyatt Vienna
positioning: Hotel in a reimagined former bank building at Am Hof, steps from Vienna's Golden Quarter shopping district
best_for: Travelers who want a historic building in central Vienna
Guests who value a spa and pool in the city centre

facts.text: The hotel occupies the reimagined former Austrian Monarchy Bank building.
The building is a sandstone structure with columns and carved embellishments.
The hotel's address is Am Hof 2, in Vienna's 1st district.
The Golden Quarter luxury shopping district is only steps away from the hotel.
Every room features elements of wood, marble and mother-of-pearl.
Bathrooms are marble, with a separate bathtub and rain shower and heated floors.
The Bank Brasserie has an open show kitchen where diners can watch the chefs at work.
Cafe Am Hof offers cakes, chocolates and tartes made by the team of Chef Patissier Oliver Ivanschits.
The Rossano Ferretti Hairspa is located in the hotel's former Living Room.
Dogs receive a Very Important Dog service with treats on arrival, a dog bed and a dog bowl.

highlights.text: The Arany Spa is set in the building's former vault, and gold-bar-shaped tiles line its swimming pool.
The Bank Brasserie & Bar is housed in the former central cashier hall.
Wall decorations are inspired by brooches designed by Art Nouveau artist Carl Otto Czeschka.
From May to October, the outdoor terrace becomes the Bollicafe, run in collaboration with Champagne Bollinger.
The Grand Salon ballroom is where bank directors of the Laenderbank once conducted negotiations.

considerations.text: Self-parking is in the public Am Hof car park in front of the hotel, which has a height restriction of 2.05 metres.
The weekend brunch at The Bank Brasserie is not available in July and August.
Children under 16 can use the spa only when accompanied by an adult, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.
